scenarios.name: Display the application bar as the top of the main window

scenario_steps.name: Home is active with no model, drawing or presentation document open
the MCAD Software is open in a restored window showing Home
the quick access toolbar is configured to appear above the ribbon
the application bar forms the top of the window with no separate system title bar
quick access command icons sit at the leading side of the application bar
the application or active document title occupies the same bar
Minimize, Maximize and Close sit at the trailing edge in that order
the controls are distinguishable by their icons and accessible names
